text.description_html:
First Impressions 1.5" Diameter Mahogany Shower Door Handle, Pair

From the new First Impressions Teak Wood collection this 1-1/2" diameter door handle features the warmth and beauty of solid Mahogany. Hand made in the USA by the expert craftsmen at First Impressions International.

Mahogany is used for these door pulls because of it's hard, strong, durable characteristics. It is also resistant to insects and warping, even when exposed directly to harsh weather, making it the ideal choice for exterior doors.

The Mahogany handle is unstained in its natural color. Staining is not required.

Specifications for First Impressions SD-RB Mahogany1.5 Shower Door Pulls

  • Pull Length: 12"
  • Center to Center: 8"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Total Projection: 3-1/8"
  • Pull Clearance: 1-5/8"
  • Pull Handle Material: Solid Mahogany
  • Mounting Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Mounting Bracket Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze

Note: Hand made to order in the USA The Center to Center Mounting distance can be adjusted for your specific application. Please Contact Us with your requirements.

Packaged Standard Back to back mounted for 1/2" glass.

*Sold as a pair.
